text: Halsteth Ravenwood is a night elf located at the Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.

Han'jin is an ice troll warrior of the Drakkari tribe who has been uniting camps of hunting parties in the Borean Tundra. They are currently building a more permanent base while inviting other camps to join them. If Han'jin keeps the hunters united, he will become the ruler of a small town, and the Drakkari will become a major threat to the tuskarr and anyone else roaming the Borean Tundra.
Halrik is a human from the who fought with his fellow soldiers in against the invading trolls.

Handor is an orc cloth and leather armor vendor located in the Kodohide Leatherworkers shop in the Drag in Orgrimmar. After Vol'jin's death, he was seen sitting with Tamar in the middle of the building.
Hans Weston is a human armor and shield vendor located on Theramore Isle of Dustwallow Marsh. It's unknown if he survived the Attack on Theramore Isle.
Haneth is a human infiltrator. She was married to Stovros. She is a companion to Trant.

Handsome Terry is a human pirate with the Northsea Freebooters found on the shore near Scalawag Point in the Howling Fjord. He will be hostile until the completion of some of the Fury of the Kvaldir quest chain. He becomes particularly cooperative after Street "Cred".

Hannah Bridgewater is a human located at Teegan's Expedition in the Southern Barrens. After the death of Deathwing, Hannah was sent to the Northwatch Hold to inform the Alliance about the attacking Horde. During the Fourth War, she was encountered by Horde champions in the Wailing Caverns.
Hann Ibal is an elite gnome and the leader of the G-Team, a small group within the S.A.F.E.

Captain Harcort was a Theramore soldier under Colonel Lorena. When Lorena received an order from Kristoff to lead Northwatch Hold's forces, Harcort was amongst those whom Lorena chose as her senior staff. However, Lorena did not go to Northwatch and instead went to search Jaina Proudmoore. She succeeded and Harcort and the others returned to Theramore Isle. It is unknown whether he survived the destruction of Theramore.
Harald is a human food vendor found in Zul'Aman. He has been hexxed into a frog waiting to be saved. He sells Sealed Scroll Case.
Harbormaster Korak is an orc located at the Ironhold Harbor in Tanaan Jungle.

Handel Shadereaver is a blood elf follower located at the Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern. Prior to the Battle for the Broken Shore, like many other followers, she appears at the Dranosh'ar Blockade at the sparring ring, where champions duel in preparation for the assault on the Broken Shore.
Hans'gar is one of the two orc brawlers in Blackrock Foundry.
Hankerin Ferinale is a dwarf located within Greywatch in Stormheim.
Handy Bill is a human located at Castaway Point in Tiragarde Sound.
Handyman Ebert is a human located in Brennadam in Stormsong Valley.
Hannah Steel is a human located at the Deadwash in Stormsong Valley. She can be seen working on a broken sword.
Handyman Lightgrove is a human located in Hops, Line, & Sinker Brewing in Boralus.
Hannah Zelling is a human located at Tidebreak Summit in Stormsong Valley.
Hansu is a human located in Camp Antonidas in the Azure Span.
Hans Stoutguard is a dwarf located in Camp Nowhere in the Azure Span.
Hanishra is a green dragon in night elf visage located at Algeth'ar Academy in Thaldraszus.

Harkyn Grymstone is a determined dwarven dragon hunter. He's sought revenge against all dragons, regardless of their nature. Harkyn Grymstone has three odd companions in his team of fellow bounty hunters, Groth, Voll, and Snee.
Harick Boulderdrum is a dwarf wand vendor located in the Mystic Ward in Ironforge. he works in the Fighting Wizard.
Harlon Thornguard is a night elf armor and shield vendor located in Lor'danel in Darkshore. Before the Cataclysm, he was in Auberdine.
Harold Riggs is a human fishing trainer located in Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.
Hartash is an orc weapon vendor located in Stonard in the Swamp of Sorrows.
Harold Lane is a human part of Hemet Nesingwary's group of hunters. He can be found at the Nesingwary Safari in Nagrand and later in Borean Tundra near Lake Kum'uya.
Harroc is an orc farmhand working in the garden of Rokar Bladeshadow's house northeast of Razor Hill in Durotar, just to the east of Razorwind Canyon.

Harold Lagras is a human diver located at Daggercap Bay in the Howling Fjord. He claims he is on a mission given to him by Vice Admiral Keller to retrieve supplies from the shipwrecks of Daggercap, and asks adventurers to help him (given how surprised he reacted, he is probably a treasure hunter who wants all of the "goodies" for himself).
Harold Haggler is a Forsaken general goods vendor in Venomspite in the Dragonblight.
Hargen Bronzewing is a dwarf gryphon riding trainer located in the stables at Honor Hold in Hellfire Peninsula.
Hardknuckle Matriarch is the leader of the Hardknuckle gorillas in Sholazar Basin. She can only be summoned by tormenting the Softknuckles.

Hargash is an orc in the goblin town of Ratchet in the Northern Barrens. He is keeping an eye the forsaken Sashya. When Horde adventurers had her Helbrim's Research he walks over to them confiscates the research so it may be sent to Orgrimmar for study and mentions Garrosh's distrust towards the forsaken and the Battle of Angrathar the Wrathgate. He ends it by telling Horde adventurers to be aware of where their loyalties lie.
Harkkan is a Dragonmaw orc located at Bloodgulch in the Twilight Highlands.

Chieftain Hargal was an orc chieftain of an unknown clan sometime before the rise of the Old Horde, but at a time when orcs had encountered the summoning of dreadlords. His life is now remembered through four artifacts which can be found using archaeology in Outland.
Harry No-Hooks is a dwarven member of the Bloodsail Buccaneers. He is found aboard The Crimson Veil in the Cape of Stranglethorn. He is the companion and alcohol vendor for the Bloodsail Buccaneers.
Hareem Helheim is a human located at Lion's Landing in the Krasarang Wilds.
Harley Soubrette is a blood elf follower located at the Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Harris Franklin is a Forsaken general goods vendor found at the Forsaken Front in Silverpine Forest.

Harrison McCabe is a dwarf located within Greywatch in Stormheim. He is drinking and playing a game of Hearthstone with Derek Testerman, discussing the validity of having brought cannons with them to Stormheim.
Harris Hocking is a human located at Hocking's Plot in Drustvar.
Harold is a human located in Millstone Hamlet in Stormsong Valley.
Harold Beckett is a human located in Foxhollow Woods in Tiragarde Sound.
Harold Farthing is a human located in Stromgarde Keep in the Arathi Highlands.
Harold Dawson was a human located in Dalaran. He sold paladin glyphs.
Harutt Thunderhorn is a tauren warrior trainer located in Camp Narache in Mulgore.
General Hath was the commander of the forces of the Kingdom of Alterac during the Second War.
Hatherford Inspector is a human located at Hatherford in Tiragarde Sound.
Hatherford Worker is a human located at Hatherford in Tiragarde Sound.
Harv Sampson is a human located in Millstone Hamlet in Stormsong Valley.
Hati's Bond is a Beast Mastery hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Beast Master (hunter artifact trait) trait.
Harvester Smasher is a human who was taken out by Alliance champions.
Hayden Christophen is a human honor quartermaster at Lion's Redoubt in Valley of the Four Winds.
Hazelyn Kyuujara is a night elf located at Southport in the Spires of Arak.
Hazel is a human located in Mariner's Row in Boralus. She can be found running back and forth, down the street behind the Curious Octopus.
Hawkmaster Lloyd is a human located at Greystone Relief in Tiragarde Sound. He has a pet named Leonard.
Hayworth is a human located in the Brennadam in Stormsong Valley.
Hauke Hartford is a human located at the Tradewinds Market in Boralus.
Haughton Francis is a human located in Freehold in Tiragarde Sound during the Alliance War Campaign.
Healing Shell is a Marksmanship hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Mark of the Windrunner and Legacy of the Windrunners (artifact trait) traits.
Heart was a yeti of the Feral Scar and a sister of the tribe's leader with the same name. She was killed by the Gordunni ogres who invaded the haven, their home.
Headteacher Doragosa is a blue dragon located at Algeth'ar Academy in Thaldraszus.
Healing Chorus is a Holy priest talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Prayer Circle.
Heggin Stonewhisker is a rare mob dwarf found by the Bael Modan crane in the Barrens. He is on a 4-6 hour respawn timer.
Heavy Repercussions is a warrior talent in the Protection tree.
Heavenly Voice is a Tier 6 Holy priest talent introduced in patch 4.3.0 which increases the healing done by Divine Hymn and reduces the cooldown.
Heartstop Aura was a Frost death knight PvP talent. It was available at level 50.
Heather is a human located in the Temple of Five Dawns on the Wandering Isle. She is reading a scroll and occasionally applauds and sends kisses to Rhonda.
Heavy Ammo is a row 8 Marksmanship hunter talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Light Ammo.

Hegnar Rumbleshot is a dwarf gunsmith located in a camp by the road from Coldridge Pass to Kharanos in Dun Morogh. He supplies local hunters and militia with guns, and also owns a practice range that many dwarves use to good effect. Because of his business, ammo is in high demand. Loslor Rudge is the engineer who supplies him.

Heldan Galesong is a night elf fish vendor located by the beach at the point where the Long Wash became the Twilight Shore, just west of Ameth'Aran in Darkshore. He was presumably killed in the Cataclysm, as he is nowhere to be found.

Helenia Olden is a human trade goods vendor located on Theramore Isle of Dustwallow Marsh. She can be found in the first house on the left when entering Theramore Isle from the boat or the gryphon. It's unknown if she survived the Attack on Theramore Isle, though an NPC called "Theramore Citizen" in the Siege of Orgrimmar has her exact appearance.
Hekkru is an orc stable master located in Stonard in the Swamp of Sorrows.
Hel'jara was a member of the Sisters of Elune who was killed by shrapnel from a plummeting infernal.
Helen Fairchild is a human located in Valgarde in the Howling Fjord.
Helga Rumsbane is a dwarf general goods vendor located in Fort Wildervar in the Howling Fjord.
Heldgarr Steelbeard is a dwarven hunter located in Valiance Keep in the Borean Tundra. Equipped with his gun, he is practicing his shooting alongside Ferlynn Windsong.

Hellak Darkhorn was a tauren warrior in the service of the Alliance. He mistrusts the orcs because he thinks they are to quick to fight and willing to do it dirty, because of their demon-tainted history. He felt that the humans possessed a core of honor, and he serves the Alliance as a scout. During a scouting mission he had a run-in with H'jalla Danfour, Hellak told the human warrior that he was in the service of the Alliance, Hellak noticed but too late that H'jalla was in the service of the Horde. H'jalla had envenomed her weapon and the poison stopped Hellak's heart.
Hegrid Blazewing is a Wildhammer dwarf general goods vendor located at the Twilight Overlook in Deepholm.
Helga Bonehewer is an orc found on the Skybag in the Brawl'gar Arena.
Heliana was a human from Lordaeron. Her nephew wanted her inheritance. Her current whereabouts are unknown.
Hellish Imp is an imp demon located at Despair Ridge on Mardum.
Hellcarver is a Survival hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Iron Talons and Raptor's Cry traits.
Helena Gentle is a witch located at the Fallhaven in Drustvar.
Hellscream's Sentry is an orc located in Tol Barad and in Tol Barad Peninsula.

Helga Nesingwary is a dwarf that would appear in Gorgrond where she would be hallucinating. She was to be the daughter of Hemet Nesingwary and would have two assistants: Greblin Fastfizzle and Zanky Zapspark.
Helda is an orc who traveled with Karg through the Stonetalons to Thunder Bluff to learn with the tauren. They were ambushed by five Grimtotem clan tauren.

Captain Helvas Grange is a commander of a unit of scouts in the Night Watch militia. He is a courageous leader and hero. Grange has good leadership skills and a sound knowledge of military tactics. He and his unit sometimes join other units to work under the direction of Commander Althea Ebonlocke.

Henrig Lonebrow was a dwarf who traveled to Kalimdor and was ordered by Prospector Khazgorm in Bael Modan to travel to through the Barrens; Khazgorm had uncovered a fossil which the site scholars believed to be a bone fragment of an ancient god, and Henrig was to discover more fossils to piece together the story. On the second day he traveled south through the vast and expansive lands of the Barrens, his long and arduous trek had yielded nothing of interest for the Explorers' League archives. When he traveled along the Gold Road, he noticed some quilboars, from which he hid from and let pass, leaving a foul stench behind. On the third day he came across a grand find: massive remains of what

Henry Zykes is a level 31 human surveyor patrolling the road between Honor's Stand and the Overgrowth in the Southern Barrens, alongside his two Survey Assistants. He is drawing up maps to help the Northwatch Expeditionary Force get a lay of the land, where they plan to build a large highway from Theramore into the Barrens. Kilrok Gorehammer, upon finding this out, sent adventurers to kill him, commenting that his name sounded weak and thin.
Henry Lew was a human Battle for Gilneas battlemaster located in the Hall of Arms in the Military Ward in Ironforge. He only appeared during the Call to Arms: Battle for Gilneas.
Heng Cloudhammer was a Wildhammer dwarf Twin Peaks battlemaster located in the Hall of Arms in the Military Ward in Ironforge. He only appeared during the Call to Arms: Twin Peaks.
Hemish Drexler is a human located at the Lunarfall in if the Alchemy Lab is built.
Hemmit Armstrong was a human found in Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills. With the destruction of Southshore by Forsaken plague bombing in Cataclysm, his fate is unclear.

Helya is the ruler of Helheim, the underworld of the cursed and fallen vrykul who do not ascend to the Halls of Valor. In ages past, she was a titan-forged watcher and sorceress and the adopted daughter of Keeper Odyn. When she spoke out against Odyn, he forcefully transformed her into the first of the spectral Val'kyr, tasked with bringing the souls of fallen vrykul to the keeper's Halls of Valor to become his Valarjar champions. The corrupted keeper Loken eventually convinced Helya to turn against Odyn by imprisoning him and the Valarjar in the Halls of Valor. She subsequently created her own afterlife, Helheim, where unworthy vrykul souls are transformed into vengeful kvaldir. Helya creat
Hera Copeland is a human located at Anglepoint Wharf in Tiragarde Sound.

Henrick Wyther is a human located at Maps, Scrolls & Mysteries in Tradewinds Market in Boralus. He's a bit of a conspiracy nut. Guards advise not to laugh at his maps and notes. He takes that stuff very seriously, and he's a nice guy.
Henrik is a human located in Stromgarde Keep in Arathi Highlands during the Battle for Stromgarde.
Helmsman Lenard is a human located on the Alliance ship sailing to Exile's Reach. He is not seen post Brace for Impact (Alliance).
Heraat is a man'ari eredar located in the Annihilan Pits in Krokuun. He is an ally of Arzaal and provides an Argunite Cluster when spoken to.
Herod is an elite human boss found in the Scarlet Monastery's Armory. He used and dropped Herod's Shoulder, the Raging Berserker's Helm and the axe Ravager (axe).

Herbalist Pomeroy is a human herbalist and artisan herbalism trainer located in a house in the hills east of the Stormwind gates in Elwynn Forest. She can be found inside the house, beside Alchemist Mallory.

Hermidia is a Forsaken human female. The woman's body is twisted and deformed, as if by some crippling ailment. There is no hiding the sores that riddle her rotting skin. She is a fighter, and speaks Common.
Heroes' Frostfire Garb is the 10-man version of the tier 7 mage set.
Heroes' Redemption Regalia is the 10-man version of the tier 7 holy paladin set.
Heroes' Cryptstalker Battlegear is the 10-man version of the tier 7 hunter set.
Heroes' Dreamwalker Battlegear is the 10-man version of the tier 7 feral druid set.
Heroes' Dreamwalker Garb is the 10-man version of the tier 7 balance druid set.
Heroes' Dreamwalker Regalia is the 10-man version of the tier 7 restoration druid set.
Heroes' Scourgeborne Battlegear is the 10-man version of the tier 7 damage death knight set.
Heroes' Redemption Battlegear is the 10-man version of the tier 7 retribution paladin set.
Heroes' Redemption Plate is the 10-man version of the tier 7 protection paladin set.
Heroes' Plagueheart Garb is the 10-man version of the tier 7 warlock set.
Heroes' Bonescythe Battlegear is the 10-man version of the tier 7 rogue set.
Heroes' Scourgeborne Plate is the 10-man version of the tier 7 tank death knight set.
Heroes' Dreadnaught Plate is the 10-man version of the tier 7 tank warrior set.
Heroes' Dreadnaught Battlegear is the 10-man version of the tier 7 damage warrior set.

Cog Captain Herk Winklespring is a gnome who was formerly a captain in Gelbin Mekkatorque's personal squadron, serving directly under the High Tinker himself. As a member of G.E.A.R., he plays a prominent role in the Heritage of Gnomeregan questline. He later joins Tinkmaster Overspark's expedition to Mechagon.
Hereward Stonecleave is a dwarf paladin located at the Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Herrathos Starstaff is a night elf priest located at the Lunarfall in . He can be recruited as a follower using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Hester Blackember is a dwarf located at the Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Hestiah Ravenwood is a night elf located at Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.

High Deathpriest Isidorus is a member of the Scourge and has been captured by Thassarian and his minion Lurid. Currently, Lurid is interrogating him at the Wailing Ziggurat in the Borean Tundra. It is unknown what happens to him after his interrogation by Lurid.
Zangus is an orc member of the Cult of the Damned. He leads the Anub'ar in the Pit of Narjun.
High Oracle Soo-say is the leader of the Oracles and is located in Rainspeaker Canopy.
High Arcanist Savor is a Forsaken mage located inside the Sunreaver's Sanctuary in Dalaran.

High Commander Kamses is the leader of the Ramkahen army, known as the "Sword of Ramkahen"; as such, he is also a member of the Ramkahen High Council. He is located at the Ramkahen Legion Outpost, overseeing the training of his troops. During the Assault in Uldum, he is found back in Ramkahen near King Phaoris. He also appears in the Vision of the Twisting Sands.
High Explorer Dellorah is a dwarf in Ulduar. During the Assault in Uldum, she is found in Ramkahen near King Phaoris.

High Executor Crenshaw is a Forsaken general taking part in the invasion of Gilneas. He is seen meeting with Lady Sylvanas and General Warhowl during The Hunt For Sylvanas. Warhowl reminds the Dark Lady that use of the Forsaken Blight is strictly forbidden, though neither the Banshee Queen nor Crenshaw seem too eager to heed his opinion. Crenshaw's fate after the invasion is unknown.
High Cleric Alphus is a gnome priest found in the townhall of Hearthglen in the Western Plaguelands.
Hidra is an orc who was caught in by the Emerald Nightmare in Orgrimmar.
High Enforcer Thranok is an orc of the Dragonmaw clan during the Galakras encounter in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
Hexlord Raal is a member of the Zanchuli Council and the high priest of Pa'ku. He is the husband of Wardruid Loti, the high priestess of Gonk.
Hexthralled Lieutenant is a human located at the Watchman's Rise in Drustvar.

Hiamo is a tauren soldier of the Horde. A few weeks before the War of the Thorns, he served as a guard in Orgrimmar. One morning, he was one of several guards who sat drinking and laughing with Morka Bruggu, who couldn't remember the tauren's name and thought of him as "Lanagu" or "Lanagas" or "something like that". When High Overlord Saurfang came upon the drunken guards, he gave them a furious lecture and ordered them to return to their posts, which they all numbly complied with. Later, during the War of the Thorns, Hiamo was one of several raiders who swam off the coast of Darkshore to attack the night elven ships and helped Morka take control of one of the kaldorei vessels.
High Explosive Trap is a row 6 hunter talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Intimidation.
Hexigosa was a blue dragon who was killed by Neltharion's betrayal during the War of the Ancients. Her name is on a Crumbling Gravestone at the Veiled Ossuary.

High Tinker is a title granted to the elected leader of the gnomes, chosen by common consent, based on the merits of their work. Despite this, it does not hold any legal authority to compel gnomes to listen to the High Tinker; meaning it serves as a figurehead and representative chosen to speak for the gnomes by virtue of respect. After the departure of King Mechagon four hundred years ago, gnomes moved away from monarchy, choosing instead to elect one of their own to the office of High Tinker. The current High Tinker is Gelbin Mekkatorque, who has held the office for several decades. After the irradiation of Gnomeregan, Mekkatorque led his people from Tinker Town in Ironforge, until he led

High Protector Lorik was a level 61 elite human found in Hearthglen. He was a paladin of the Scarlet Crusade. He was guarding Mardenholde Keep, the fortress of the Scarlet Crusade within the Western Plaguelands. During the events of the Ashbringer, he alongside Durgen defended Hearthglen from the Scourge.

High Priest Venoxis was the Zandalari High Priest of the Primal God Hethiss, the snake god. Sent to Zul'Gurub to stop Hakkar the Soulflayer, he was turned by the blood god and had to be slain at the Zandalari's behest.
High Protector Tarsen is a human of the Scarlet Crusade, found near the Northridge Lumber Camp in the Western Plaguelands.

High Warlord Cromush is a Mag'har orc high warlord, who attended the meeting where Sylvanas Windrunner showed Garrosh Hellscream how the Val'kyr raise the dead into new Forsaken. Both the High Warlord and the Warchief himself were disgusted by this, and to make sure the forsaken won't be up to any tricks, Garrosh dispensed Cromush to "guard" Sylvanas. Cromush took this charge without question, though appeared to be far more tolerant of the Forsaken than some other orcs in the Eastern Kingdoms. After a long hiatus, Cromush returned to aid the Horde war effort during the Fourth War.

High Overseer Bloodmane was a logistics officer for the Horde. He was once usually found at The Dranosh'ar Blockade in Durotar, standing on opposite side of the road facing Holgar Stormaxe, but was promoted to Overseer of Razor Hill where he met his demise.
High Sorceress Aryna is a gnome mage found in Ragefire Chasm.
High Shaman MacKilligan is a Wildhammer dwarf who patrols the Thundermar Ruins in the Twilight Highlands.
Highguard Kailus is a human royal guard sworn to protect King Varian Wrynn during the Siege of Orgrimmar. He takes part in the Galakras encounter.
Highguard Tyrius is a human royal guard sworn to protect King Varian Wrynn during the Siege of Orgrimmar. He takes part in the Galakras encounter.
High Sage Viryx is the arakkoa leader of the Adherents of Rukhmar after betraying her former clutch-brother Iskar.

High Priestess Mourn is a Forsaken priest located in the south-eastern alcove in Netherlight Temple. Mourn can be used to recruit Hooded Priest follower troops, but will only appear if the player has researched the Hooded Priests class hall advancement.
Highcrest Recluse is a proto-dragon located in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

Highlord Demitrian is a human located at the Ravaged Twilight Camp in Silithus. He is a major character in the quest-line to get Thunderfury, Blessed Blade of the Windseeker. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, he was approached by the Earthen Ring. Miraculously, he survived Sargeras's destruction of Silithus and is located in the Crystal Vale. During the Fourth War, he went to the Wailing Caverns to harvest :Azerite, but was stopped.
Highlord Mastrogonde is a rare mob human found in Firewatch Ridge in the Searing Gorge.
Hilda Stoneforge is a dwarf located in Valiance Keep in the Borean Tundra.
Highlord Leoric Von Zeldig is a human paladin of the 7th Legion and a member of the Knights of the Silver Hand. He was one of the leaders of the Might of Kalimdor until it was disbanded.
Hilda Runesworn is a dwarf located in the small camp of Gunstan's Dig in Tanaris. She's a member of the Explorer's League.

Hildie Hackerguard is a gnome rogue captain of the Alliance, who served in Ashran and would later appear at Raven's Glory, the Black Rook Hold arena. In Ashran, Hackerguard or another random Alliance Captain will spawn each time the Alliance reinforcements total reaches 200 or 100.
Hildr Helhammer is a dwarf located at the Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Hilda Hammerfast is a dwarf located in Vulture's Nest in Vol'dun.
Hilde Firebreaker is a Dark Iron dwarf located in Gol Thovas in Tiragarde Sound.
Hildegosa is a blue dragon located in the Sapphire Enclave in Valdrakken. She lives with Sabigosa, Zelagosa, and their cat Peabody.
Hjoldir Stoneblade is a dwarf blade vendor located in the Forlorn Cavern in Ironforge. He is located inside the Stoneblade's shop, and is probably its owner.
Hogral Bakkan is a dwarf rogue trainer located in Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, in the dwarven starting zone of Dun Morogh. During the Legion Invasions, he defended the town.

Hogan Ference is a human that resides in the town of Darkshire. He used to visit his father's grave, but now it's harder to do. During the third invasion of the Burning Legion, Hogan was killed by the fanatical Night Watchers who joined the Veiled Hand cult.
Private Hoban was a human killed by an orc named Gorx during the battle of Northwatch Hold. Corporal Rych avenged his death by killing Gorx back.

Historian Ju'pa is a jungle troll member of the Timewalkers investigating the Timeless Isle alongside Kairoz. He is found at the Whispershade Hollow. During Warcraft's Anniversary, Ju'pa could be found in the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar, acting as the Horde counterpart to Historian Llore. Staring with the WoW's 15th Anniversary, Ju'pa and Llore appeared in the Caverns of Time during the anniversary events.
Hoddruc Bladebender is a Dark Iron dwarf located in Chiselgrip in Burning Steppes.
Hilseth Travelstride is a night elf vendor found walking on the road in the Field of Dreamers in Val'sharah.
Hogarth Reed is a human located at Eckhart Lodge in Stormsong Valley.

Holt Thunderhorn is a tauren hunter trainer located on Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff. He directs hunters to Ormak Grimshot for questing. Like many other hunters across the world, Holt joined the Unseen Path when the Burning Legion returned. He began working at Trueshot Lodge as a lore compiler and researcher on the artifacts of the Huntmaster and how they recovered them. He recorded his findings into the Tales of the Hunt.

Homer Stonefield is a human fruit vendor located on the Stonefield Farm in Elwynn Forest. He is the patriarch of the Stonefield family and is in charge of their farm. He can be found just outside the barn.
Honni Goldenoat is a dwarf bread vendor located in Stoutlager Inn in Thelsamar in Loch Modan.
Holy Specialization is a tier 1 priest talent in the Holy tree. It increases the critical chance of the priest's holy spells.
Holy Reach is a fourth tier priest talent in the holy tree. It increases the range and radius of certain spells.

Holgar Stormaxe is an orc located at the Dranosh'ar Blockade in Durotar, just outside the entrance of Orgrimmar. Just prior to the Battle for Broken Shore, he was seen handling the arrival of new Horde Recruits at the Blockade. Shortly before the Burning of Teldrassil, he acknowledged new soldiers coming from Orgrimmar to the rest of the army gathered at the Blockade. Holgar was present at the first Azerothian Kosh'harg in Razor Hill, initially sharing a table with Commander Thorak.
Honagger Bradwarden is a dwarf warrior. While taking a trip near Ironforge, he was attacked by a group of wolves.
Holgom is an orc located at The High Road in Southern Barrens near Tunawa Stillwind. He has plans to retake Honor's Stand from the Alliance.

Honor Guard Dunstad is a dwarf that originally guarded King Magni Bronzebeard in Old Ironforge. During Children's Week, he explained Magni's fate to Randis. After Magni awoke and left Ironforge, Dunstad was posted to the High Seat instead, standing next to Royal Historian Archesonus.
Holy Hands is a Holy priest artifact trait. It is linked to the Follower of the Light and Reverence (artifact trait) traits.
Holy Mending is a Holy priest artifact trait. It is linked to the Say Your Prayers (artifact trait) trait.
Honor's Stand Caravan Leader was a human located in Northern Barrens.
Honed Warblades is a vengeance demon hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Will of the Illidari (artifact trait) and Charred Warblades (artifact trait) traits.
Holger Nash is a human located in Saltstone Mine in Stormsong Valley. Upon being rescued, he goes to Beacon Hill.
Holloway Fjordhammer was a dwarf located in Dalaran. He sold hunter glyphs.
Honora Keystone is a dwarf located at the Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Honu Staghunter was a tauren hunter held in a Quilboar Cage in Mulgore.
Horde Field Scout is an orc pvp rewards vendor located at Zabra'jin in Zangarmarsh. He is in one of the raised huts, looking out to the north. His Alliance counterpart is Alliance Field Scout.
Horde Commander is the high commander of the Horde forces invading The Nexus.
Horizon Scout Cook is a human supposedly trapped within the captain's quarters of the Horizon Scout off the shore of Azshara.
Horizon Scout First Mate is a human supposedly trapped within the captain's quarters of the Horizon Scout off the shores of Azshara.
Horgrenn Hellcleave is a murderer, who was to be executed, but after he strangled the hangman with his left hand, Conqueror Krenna handed him over to Grennix Shivwiggle, to use him as a gladiator.
Horkchortle is an orc vendor located at the Rangari Refuge in Tanaan Jungle.
Horatio Mueller is a human located in Hatherford in Tiragarde Sound.
Horguk Halftooth is an orc located in Stonefist Watch in Tiragarde Sound.
Hopistella is a night elf located at Algeth'ar Academy in Thaldraszus.
Houndmaster Loksey is an elite human mini-boss located in the Scarlet Monastery's Library wing.

Hortus (real name unknown) is a former member of Blizzard Entertainment's creative development team, and a former quality assurance representative thereof. He likes punch and pie. He has not posted since the launch of the new forums.

Houndmaster Grebmar Fleabeard is an elite dwarf mini-boss in the Blackrock Depths. He resides under the arena with his pack of pet dogs. Because he is rather out of the way, most groups running the instance won't bother with him, though he drops a fairly good caster cloak, the Spritecaster Cape. He is soloable by most classes, but getting to him is difficult for any non-stealth classes.
Howin Kindfeather is a Wildhammer dwarf standing next to Claira Kindfeather in Aerie Peak in the Hinterlands. He can occasionally be seen walkling around the town.
Howling Wolvar Chieftain is a wolvar and the leader of the Howling tribe and is located on the Cauldros Isle in the Howling Fjord.
Hovic is a soldier of Stormwind. King Varian Wrynn assured him that they would win the war against the Scourge. It's unknown what happened to him after the undead attack.
Houndmaster Braun is a human located in the Scarlet Halls wing of the Scarlet Monastery. He serves as the first boss of the dungeon.
Horzog is an orc located at the Remains of the Fleet in the Twilight Highlands. He is one of the survivors from the twilight assault on the fleet.

Horuz Killcrow was a storied dwarf warrior who participated in the battle with the dread wyrm, Kaldrigos. The grave mistake he made during the battle cost him his life — he stood directly behind the dragon and was killed by Tail Sweep.
Howell Quilldragon is a blood elf located in a barricaded house in the Shattrath Commons in Talador. He lives here with his minion Calciferus.
Houndmaster Kerrax is a fel lord located inside a cave at the Defiled Path in the Antoran Wastes.

Houndmaster Archibald is a human located at the Amber Waves in Stormsong Valley. Occasionally, he can be seen going around the house to pet Humphrey. He sends adventurers and Humphrey to kill quilboar digging underneath.
Huklah is an orc cloth & leather armor vendor located in the Valley of Trials in Durotar.
Hraq is an orc blacksmithing vendor located at the Crossroads in the Northern Barrens. He assisted in its defense during the Legion invasions.
Hragran is an orc cloth and leather armor vendor located in Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.
Humphry is a dwarf master blacksmithing trainer and vendor located at Honor Hold in the Hellfire Peninsula.

Hult was a soldier under the command of Major Remka. He was part of the group that captured Thrall and sent him to an internment camp. Hult taunted Thrall, and planned to keep a knife found in Thrall's possession, before a superior reprimanded him. His status is unknown.
Hull Forgehammer is a dwarf blacksmithing vendor located in Marshtide Watch in the Swamp of Sorrows.
Humbert Tanwell is a human skinning trainer located in Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh. It's unknown if he survived the Attack on Theramore Isle.

Huga was a human mage who worked in a library in Dalaran and was known by its students. She was also a member of the Council of Tirisfal 2,600 years before the First War. She battled against Kathra'natir who stole the Amulet of Waters.
Humble Sak'ko is an orc innkeeper located at Wor'gol in Frostfire Ridge.

Hulda Shadowblade is a Dark Iron dwarf located at the Southport in Spires of Arak. She first appears when Kolrigg Stoktron has been poisoned by orc and traveled to Shadow's Vigil in hopes of finding a cure. After interrogating some orcs, she found out that the one behind this was Gardul Venomshiv. Taking his recipe of the poison and disrupting his work, she was able to create an antidote and saved Kolrigg just in time. After this, she becomes a follower.
Hungering Rune Weapon is a level 58 Frost death knight talent.
Human Warrior was a human located in Talador. She was taken out by the followers sent from the Frostwall garrison.
Huinli Wingpaw is a pandaren monk trainer located in the Barracks in Orgrimmar.
Hurklor is an orc blacksmithing vendor located in Plate-n-Chain in Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
Hurnak Grimmord is a dwarf master mining trainer located at Honor Hold in the Hellfire Peninsula. He can be found in the forge building of Honor Hold
Huntress Ravenoak is a night elf found patrolling the walkways of Darnassus. It is unknown whether she survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.
Huntress Skymane is a night elf found patrolling the walkways of Darnassus. It is unknown whether she survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.
Hurley Hoppleham is a Wildhammer dwarf food & drink vendor located at Firebeard's Patrol in the Twilight Highlands.

Huntress Jalin is a night elf located at Stardust Spire in Ashenvale. As the leader of the forces at the Spire, she is focused on saving Alliance comrades and stopping the Horde from advancing further across Kalimdor. She asked adventurers to rescue Boog the "Gear Whisperer" Minx from Painmaster Thundrak's Wagon of Unending Agony and to kill Chief Bombgineer Sploder. She also learned about the Horde's bomb. Her rank is equal to Horde's warlord. During the Fourth War, she led her Sentinels against Silverwind Refuge, attempting to retake it for the Alliance. She was encountered by Horde champions. Jalin is still leading the Spire after the war. She and her Sentinel warriors doggedly patrol the

Huntress Kuzari is a jungle troll hunter trainer located next to Berserker Zanga in the Valley of Spirits of Orgrimmar. She has a pet tiger named Mimbubu and is giving lessons to a group of Darkspear Headhunters. She was present at the funeral ceremony of Vol'jin in the Dranosh'ar Blockade and later joined the Unseen Path in the Trueshot Lodge. She is also seen in Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore.
Huo is the ancient spirit of Fire on the Wandering Isle. For too long he stood sleeping, the people missing his warmth, until he was waken up by a pandaren adventurer.
Hurricane Strike is a level 100 monk talent, available only to Windwalker monks.

Huntmaster Kuang is an orc who is part of the Giantslayer Hunting Party traveling from the Colossal's Fall on the Cracking Plains. They spawn at roughly just outside Colossal's Fall and patrol on a northeast-southwest line. Other members of the party: *Cloudspeaker Daber *Gronnstalker Dawarn *Giantbane (mount) *Pathfinder Jalog *Giantslayer Kimla *Beastcarver Saramor
Huntress Vael'yrie is a night elf stable master located at The Incursion in Krasarang Wilds.
Hunter Bal'ra is an orc located at the Everbloom Wilds in Gorgrond. Her pet is Spike.

Hunrik Blackiron is a Dark Iron dwarf warlock found in the Dreadscar Rift. He also appears in Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore where he maintains a Dreadscar Gateway with Zardeth of the Black Claw.
Hunter's Guile is a Survival hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Explosive Force and Lacerating Talons traits.
Hunter's Bounty is a Survival hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Raptor's Cry, My Beloved Monster, Lacerating Talons and Fluffy, Go traits.
Hungry Sam is a human located at Castaway Point in Tiragarde Sound.
Hunter Robin is a human located in Stormsong Valley. He sits with his following four friends around a Honey Vat: *Melancholy Mule *Pig *Honey Bear *Tiger
Huntsman Turney is a human located in a ruined camp along Highroad Pass in Drustvar.
Hunter's Advantage is a Beast Mastery hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Natural Reflexes and Wilderness Expert traits.
Huntmaster Theodore is a human located in the Arathi Highlands during the Battle for Stromgarde. He leads Newstead Militias.
Huntsman Russell is a human located in Grimmburg in Gilneas.
Hunter's Avoidance is a row 7 hunter talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Roar of Sacrifice.

Huntmaster Scarborgh is a human of the Scarlet Crusade located on Fenris Isle in Silverpine Forest when the crusaders attacked the Ruins of Lordaeron. He was seen patrolling the area, warning his soldiers to be alert of the undead. When the Forsaken counterattacked them on the isle, he retreated through a Scarlet Portal.

Hyku Steeledge was a massive orc blademaster who Rehgar Earthfury set on his gladiator team shortly after their fight with another team of three, to teach them to expect the unexpected. He was killed by Lo'Gosh after mistaking him for a novice gladiator, and following the rules of combat, Lo'Gosh inherited his swords.
Hutia is a porcupine spirit beast located in the Jade Forest.
Hypothermia is a Frost death knight artifact trait. It is linked to the Ambidexterity (death knight artifact trait) and Bad to the Bone traits.
Hydra's Bite is a row 10 hunter talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Poison Injection.
Hypothermic Presence is a level 45 Frost death knight talent.

Ice Block is a row 2 mage talent. It makes the caster immune to damage and negative effects for a short time. Using Ice Block debuffs the caster with Hypothermia, preventing them from using Ice Block again for 30 seconds.
